title: Normalized derived arithmetic comparison
statement: Let $C$ be a small site with topology $J$, with sheafification for abelian groups and its locally bijective characterization. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings and let $A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], in a universe containing the site and coefficients. Assume chosen derived categories of $A$ and $\operatorname{Tow}(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}},A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the arithmetic restriction $r_e$, its induced complex and derived functors, the termwise limit $L$, limit restriction $\alpha_e$, the boundary $\delta$, selection $a_e$, block map $b_e$, and mapping cocone $M$ of [def-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction-data]. Let $F:D(\operatorname{Tow}(A))\to D(A)$ with $\eta:QL\to FQ$ be a total right derived inverse limit as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], with $\eta_I$ invertible for K-injective $I$. There is a family of natural isomorphisms $\rho_e:F\cong F\circ D(r_e)$ for all $e\geq1$, normalized by $\eta_X\rho_{e,QX}F(\theta_{e,X})=Q(\alpha_{e,X})\eta_{r_eX}$, where $\theta_e:D(r_e)Q\cong Qr_e$ is the canonical localization factorization. For every complex $K$ and $u:K\to LX$, precomposition by $Q(u)$ gives the same equation with $Q(u\alpha_{e,X})$ on the right. There are canonical identity identifications $\zeta:r_1\cong\operatorname{id}$ on complexes and $\iota:D(r_1)\cong\operatorname{id}$ such that $\zeta$ is the original tower's map on the equality of each arithmetic index with itself, $\iota_{QX}=\theta_{1,X}Q(\zeta_X)$, and $\rho_{1,Z}F(\iota_Z)=1_{FZ}$ for every derived tower $Z$.

theorem strictTowerArithmeticRestrictionComparison
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max uC vC r}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max uC vC r})
    (_hcomm : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : R.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)]
    (RF : DerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R))
    (η : limitComplex (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q.{w} ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.{w} ⋙ RF)
    (_hRF : RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R)
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (_hη : ∀ I, CochainComplex.IsKInjective I → IsIso (η.app I)) :
    ∃ (ρ : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e →
        (RF ≅ derivedRestriction (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) e ⋙ RF)),
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) X,
        η.app X ≫ (ρ e he).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X) ≫
            RF.map ((restriction _ e).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app X) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (limitMap e X) ≫
            η.app ((complexRestriction _ e).obj X)) ∧
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) X (K : CochainComplex
          (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) ℤ)
          (a : K ⟶ (limitComplex _).obj X),
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map a ≫ η.app X) ≫
            (ρ e he).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X) ≫
            RF.map ((restriction _ e).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app X) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (a ≫ limitMap e X) ≫
            η.app ((complexRestriction _ e).obj X)) ∧
      (∃ (ζ : complexRestriction (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) 1 ≅ 𝟭 _)
          (ι : derivedRestriction (ringedSiteModules.{max uC vC r} R) 1 ≅ 𝟭 _),
        (∀ X (i : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
          ((ζ.hom.app X).f i).app (op n) =
            (X.X i).map (eqToHom (by simp [index]))) ∧
        (∀ X, ι.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X) =
          (restriction _ 1).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app X ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (ζ.hom.app X)) ∧
        (∀ Z, (ρ 1 (by decide)).hom.app Z ≫ RF.map (ι.hom.app Z) = 𝟙 (RF.obj Z)))
